title: Beans first. Then rustic chocolate.
lead: What Europe is asking for now is cocoa: lots from 1 kg up to distributor volumes, with about one tonne in Aveiro. The chocolates, tea and drinking powder come from the same fruit — no prices on the page, no cart.
note: Our chocolates and cocoa foods contain no gluten and no preservatives. The coconut chocolate is lactose-free; the milk chocolate uses lactose-free milk.

items.name: Cocoa beans — lots for Europe
items.description: The same high-altitude cocoa from Fazenda Eustáquio, selected for chefs, makers and distributors. Lots from 1 kg. About 1 t available in Aveiro, Portugal.

items.name: Whole peeled cocoa beans
items.description: Whole, peeled, selected beans — the farm's fruit for the kitchen and the table.
items.imageAlt: 180 g pack of peeled cocoa beans

items.name: Rustic chocolate with coconut milk
items.description: Craft chocolate made with cocoa beans, coconut milk and demerara sugar. The green on the pack is the forest the fruit comes from.

items.name: Rustic chocolate with lactose-free milk
items.description: Craft chocolate made with cocoa beans, lactose-free milk and demerara sugar. The same rustic profile, for people who want milk without lactose.
items.imageAlt: Display of rustic lactose-free milk chocolate

items.name: Cocoa tea
items.description: Made from the bean shell. A chocolate-scented tea that surprises almost everyone who tries it.

items.name: Rustic chocolate powder
items.description: Rustic chocolate powder for recipes, drinks and pastry — the farm's fruit in a cook's format.
items.imageAlt: 400 g box of rustic chocolate powder
